summary: GasLog Partners LP filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated May 28, 2026, announcing quarterly distributions on its Series A, B, and C preference units. The distributions are $0.5390625, $0.6250819, and $0.5917319 per unit, respectively, with a record date of June 8, 2026, and payment date of June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not constitute a special-situation event such as a tender offer, going-private, or other restructuring. There are no deal terms, advisor mentions, or unusual structural changes. The filing is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, and no special situation is present.
